mapper.select: select seq as accountSeq from account at where 1=1 and login_id = #{loginId}

select a.category_cd , a.category_nm , a.name as account_name , a.disease_seq , a.disease_name , a.disease_treatment , a.disease , case when (a.tot_question_step_day_cnt::decimal = 0) then 0 else round(a.tot_answer_step_day_cnt::decimal / a.tot_question_step_day_cnt::decimal * 100) end as progress from ( select ac.seq , scd.cd as category_cd , scd.val as category_nm , ac.name , ts.disease ->> 'diseaseSeq' as disease_seq , ts.disease ->> 'name' as disease_name , ts.disease -> 'diseaseTreatment' -> 0 ->> 'name' as disease_treatment , ts.disease , (select count(*) from coaching_question_info cqi where cqi.progress_type_cd in ( 'A1','E01','K01') and cqi.category_cd = scd.cd) as tot_question_step_day_cnt , (select count(distinct step_day_cd) from coaching_user_answer_info cuai where cuai.account_seq = ac.seq and cuai.category_cd = scd.cd) as tot_answer_step_day_cnt , (select max(created_at) from coaching_user_answer_info cuai where cuai.account_seq = ac.seq and cuai.category_cd = scd.cd) as created_at from account ac left join track_service ts on ac.seq = ts.account_seq and ts.status = 'ACTIVE' , sys_code_det scd where 1=1 and ac.seq = #{accountSeq} and scd.code = 'CATEGORY_CD' and scd.use_yn = 'Y' and ac.is_enabled and scd.cd in ('A','B','C','D') union all select ac.seq , scd.cd as category_cd , scd.val as category_nm , ac.name , ts.disease ->> 'diseaseSeq' as disease_seq , ts.disease ->> 'name' as disease_name , ts.disease -> 'diseaseTreatment' -> 0 ->> 'name' as disease_treatment , ts.disease , (select count(*) from coaching_user_answer_info cuai where cuai.account_seq = ac.seq and cuai.category_cd = scd.cd) as tot_question_step_day_cnt , (select count(*) from coaching_user_answer_info cuai where cuai.answer_choice = 'Y' and cuai.account_seq = ac.seq and cuai.category_cd = scd.cd) as tot_answer_step_day_cnt , (select max(created_at) from coaching_user_answer_info cuai where cuai.account_seq = ac.seq and cuai.category_cd = scd.cd) as created_at from account ac left join track_service ts on ac.seq = ts.account_seq and ts.status = 'ACTIVE' , sys_code_det scd where 1=1 and ac.seq = #{accountSeq} and scd.code = 'CATEGORY_CD' and scd.use_yn = 'Y' and ac.is_enabled and scd.cd in ('E') ) a
select exercise_program_cd , cancer_type_cd , aerobic , therapy_cd from coaching_account_exercise_class where account_seq = #{accountSeq}
select coalesce(max(seq),0) as surveySeq from coaching_exercise_survey_result_hst where 1=1 and account_seq = #{accountSeq}
mapper.insert: insert into coaching_exercise_progress_result_hst (survey_seq , account_seq , answer_choice_seq , answer_choice , ref_val1) select #{surveySeq} , #{accountSeq} , answer_choice_seq , answer_choice , ref_val1 from coaching_user_answer_info where account_seq = #{accountSeq} and category_cd = 'E' and answer_choice_seq = #{answerChoiceSeq}
mapper.update: update account_batch_schedule set is_enabled = false ,updated_at = now() where schedule_seq in (select seq from account_schedule where account_seq = #{accountSeq} and schedule_type = #{scheduleType} and is_enabled = true)
